SELECT em.org_name_local AS organization_name ,tar.employee_no AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,TO_CHAR(tar.time_and_attendance_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS time_and_attendance_date ,TO_CHAR(tar.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd_result ,TO_CHAR(tai.check_in_date, 'HH24:MI') AS in_time ,TO_CHAR(tai.check_out_date, 'HH24:MI') AS out_time ,tar.shift_type_code AS shift_type_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_DAY_NIGHT_FLAG', tar.night_shift_flag) FROM dual) AS night_shift_name ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_TYPE_CODE', tac.time_and_attendance_type_code) FROM dual) AS time_and_attendance_type_name ,tar.time_and_attendance_code AS time_and_attendance_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE', tar.time_attend_detail_code) FROM dual) AS time_attend_detail_name ,tar.work_start_time AS work_start_time ,tar.tardy_hours AS tardy_hours ,tar.early_leave_hours AS early_leave_hours ,tar.going_out_hours AS going_out_hours ,tar.overtime_sum_hours AS overtime_sum_hours ,tar.time_attend_input_reason_desc AS time_attend_input_reason_desc ,(SELECT full_name_local FROM emp_master WHERE employee_number = las.approver1_no) AS approver1_name ,(SELECT full_name_local FROM emp_master WHERE employee_number = las.approver2_no) AS approver2_name ,lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_APPROVAL_STATUS', lgvatt_common_pkg.get_approval_status(tar.approval_request_id, tar.request_code, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo})) AS approval_status
,tar.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag ,tar.weekday_overtime_hours AS weekday_overtime_hours ,tar.holiday_overtime_hours AS holiday_overtime_hours ,tar.public_holiday_overtime_hours AS public_holiday_overtime_hours ,tar.weekday_night_overtime_hours AS weekday_night_overtime_hours ,tar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours AS weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours ,tar.holiday_night_overtime_hours AS holiday_night_overtime_hours ,tar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours AS public_holiday_night_ot_hours ,tar.normal_night_overtime_hours AS normal_night_overtime_hours ,em.assignment_category AS emp_cat ,em.grade_title AS grade_title_code ,tar.base_time_attend_apply_flag AS base_time_attend_apply_flag ,lar.status_code AS approval_status_code ,las.approver1_no AS approver1_no ,las.approver2_no AS approver2_no ,lar.request_master_id AS request_master_id ,lar.request_code AS request_code ,CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(tar.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYYMM') BETWEEN ran.min_yyyymm AND ran.max_yyyymm THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS approval_enable_flag ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_approval_status(lar.request_master_id, lar.request_code, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}) AS approval_stat_cd FROM ( SELECT t.* FROM emp_master t ,( SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM org_master o WHERE o.org_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (o.org_end_date IS NULL OR o.org_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) START WITH o.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 변수: 세션 법인코드 */
AND o.organization_id IN (SELECT t.organization_id FROM emp_master t WHERE t.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND t.supervisor = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} ) /* 변수: 세션 로긴자 사번 */
AND o.organization_id = #{orgName}
CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR o.organization_id = o.parent_org_id AND PRIOR o.subsidiary_code = o.subsidiary_code ) o WHERE t.organization_id = o.organization_id AND t.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW'
AND t.employee_number like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeNo}) || '%'
AND UPPER(t.full_name_local) like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%'
) em
,tb_att_result_n tar ,tb_att_code_c tac ,tb_att_idcard_acs_time_n tai ,lgcom_approval_request_n lar ,( SELECT request_master_id AS request_master_id ,request_code AS request_code ,MAX(DECODE(approval_seqs, 1, user_no)) AS approver1_no ,MAX(DECODE(approval_seqs, 2, user_no)) AS approver2_no ,MAX(DECODE(approval_seqs, 1, approval_status_code)) AS approval1_status_code ,MAX(DECODE(approval_seqs, 2, approval_status_code)) AS approval2_status_code FROM lgcom_approval_status_n WHERE approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' GROUP BY request_master_id, request_code ) las ,(SELECT lgvatt_common_pkg.get_curr_att_yyyymm(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'FIRST') AS min_yyyymm, /* 입력/결재 가능한 처음 년월 */ lgvatt_common_pkg.get_curr_att_yyyymm(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'FINAL') AS max_yyyymm /* 입력/결재 가능한 최종 년월 */ FROM dual ) ran WHERE em.employee_number = tar.employee_no AND tar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 변수: 세션 법인코드 */ AND tar.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') /* 변수: 화면선택한 일자 : 범위일경우 차례대로 */ AND tar.subsidiary_code = tac.subsidiary_code AND tar.time_and_attendance_code = tac.time_and_attendance_code AND tar.approval_request_id = lar.request_master_id(+) AND tar.request_code = lar.request_code(+) AND lar.request_master_id = las.request_master_id(+) AND lar.request_code = las.request_code(+) AND tar.employee_no = tai.employee_no(+) AND tar.time_and_attendance_date = tai.time_and_attendance_date(+)
AND lgvatt_common_pkg.get_approval_status(lar.request_master_id, lar.request_code, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}) = #{approvaStatusCode}
ORDER BY tar.time_and_attendance_date /* 여러날짜일때 일자별로 먼저 조회 */ ,em.org_name_local ,tar.employee_no

SELECT DISTINCT o.organization_id AS code, o.org_name_local AS name FROM org_master o WHERE o.org_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (o.org_end_date IS NULL OR o.org_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) START WITH o.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 변수: 세션 법인코드 */ AND o.organization_id IN ( SELECT t.organization_id FROM emp_master t WHERE t.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND t.supervisor = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} ) /* 변수: 세션 로긴자 사번 */ CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR o.organization_id = o.parent_org_id AND PRIOR o.subsidiary_code = o.subsidiary_code
